## Fidelity preflight

`cargo xtask fidelity` runs the port forward from the nominal state and diffs states,
derivatives, measurements and the generator word against a golden oracle trace
committed to the repository. It needs no Fortran toolchain, so it runs everywhere in
about a second.

| steps diffed | worst | where | gate | trace recorded with |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 100 of 100 | 3.521323734565789e-14 | `YP(12) at step 77` | 1e-12 | gfortran 15.2.0 |
